entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes. I... I think I need to return something. It's a jersey I bought a while ago. I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... um... VF-881-2947. I hope that's right.

Thank you, Maria. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order here for the Apex Pro Jersey, delivered about 80 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, there's nothing wrong with it, it's beautiful! It's just the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a big ride and it's just way too tight. I really need to exchange it. I tried looking at the policy online and it was all very confusing... can't you just help me?

Of course, Maria, that's what I'm here for. There's no need to worry. Let me just check the policy for you... Yes, it looks like you're well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process an exchange for a different size.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried it was too late.

Not at all. And I see here you're one of our VIP members. To make this easier for you, I've just processed a return label that will be in your email shortly. I've also waived the standard shipping fee for your new size and upgraded it to 2-day express at no charge.
Wow! That's amazing. You've been so much more helpful than the website. Thank you, Isaac!
It's my pleasure, Maria. Once we receive the original jersey, your replacement will be sent out immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
